about: Parameters shared by the Python reference pipeline (msocr) and its JavaScript port (Manuscribe). Change a value here, never in either codebase, and bump version: models and fixtures name the version they were made with.
resize: every resize is PIL's Image.resize with BILINEAR on an 8-bit grey image (a triangle filter whose support widens with the scale when shrinking); the JavaScript port implements the same

lm.about: reading with the language model (msocr/lm.py, app/js/recoglm.js): a prefix beam search over the recogniser's log-probabilities, a hypothesis scoring log P(recogniser) + alpha * log P(LM) + beta * (its letters); only classes over `prune` (log probability) are tried at a column; a boundary (daṇḍa, digit, mark) right after one costs the LM log(boundary_repeat); the models of a pack (lexica, own: 6-grams, the lexica one pruned of n-grams seen under min_count times) are mixed by their weights
